title: Kristal v5 Reader Policy
description: A reader policy defines which Kristal artifacts, assertions, authority channels, validation statuses, certainty levels, and epistemic modes are visible or usable in a given reading, query, runtime, export, or agent context. Reader policy controls visibility and selection. It does not define universal truth.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this reader policy format.

canonicalization_profile.description: Canonicalization profile used when this reader policy is content-addressed or signed.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the policy was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the policy was last updated.

mode.description: High-level reader mode. This is a preset category; exact behavior is determined by the explicit filters in this policy.

allowed_artifact_statuses.description: Artifact statuses allowed by this reader policy.

allowed_assertion_statuses.description: Assertion statuses allowed by this reader policy.

allowed_validation_statuses.description: Validation statuses allowed by this reader policy.

allowed_recognition_statuses.description: Authority recognition statuses allowed by this reader policy.

allowed_certainty_levels.description: Certainty levels allowed by this reader policy.

allowed_validated_as.description: Validation modes allowed by this reader policy.

allowed_authority_channels.description: Authority channels explicitly allowed by this reader policy.

denied_authority_channels.description: Authority channels explicitly denied by this reader policy.

required_authority_channels.description: Authority channels that must recognize or validate a target before it is visible under this policy.

scope_filters.description: Optional scopes included by this reader policy. If omitted, scope is controlled by other policy fields or implementation context.

excluded_scopes.description: Optional scopes excluded by this reader policy.

include_disputed.description: Whether disputed assertions or artifacts may be visible.

include_rejected.description: Whether rejected assertions or artifacts may be visible.

include_revoked.description: Whether revoked assertions, recognitions, or artifacts may be visible.

include_retracted.description: Whether retracted assertions may be visible.

include_superseded.description: Whether superseded assertions or artifacts may be visible.

include_not_evaluated.description: Whether not-yet-evaluated assertions or artifacts may be visible.

include_unrecognized.description: Whether artifacts or assertions without authority recognition may be visible.

include_fictional.description: Whether fictional corpora or fictional assertions may be visible.

include_mythological.description: Whether mythological corpora or mythological assertions may be visible.

include_symbolic.description: Whether symbolic models may be visible.

include_local_notes.description: Whether local notes or personal working material may be visible.

show_labels.description: Whether the reader surface must show or preserve labels such as authority channel, validation status, certainty level, scope, and dispute status.

required_visible_labels.description: Labels that must be visible or inspectable when present.

fallback_behavior.description: Behavior when a target does not satisfy this reader policy or cannot be evaluated against it.

conflict_strategy.description: How the reader handles conflicting claims visible under the policy.

overlap_strategy.description: How the reader handles overlapping assertions or shards.

authority_precedence.description: Ordered authority channels used when conflict_strategy or overlap_strategy depends on authority precedence.

projection.description: Optional projection mode requested by this reader policy.

export_compatibility.description: Optional export behavior for readers that also produce derived artifacts.

reason_codes.description: Optional machine-readable reasons for this policy configuration.

policy_refs.description: External or upstream policies this reader policy depends on.

signatures.description: Signatures over this reader policy according to the active signature profile.

attestations.description: Optional attestations attached to this reader policy.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific additional fields. Extensions must not change v5 core reader-policy semantics.
